$comment: Port policy (docs/adr/0003-survev-baseline.md, docs/design/survev-content-and-new-guns.md section 5.1). survevOnlyGameObjects: survev-only game objects ported as survev has them, appended after every original id in survev order (the owner, 2026-10-07: add what only survev.io has, the guns first). survevSkins: survev-only reskins built from the original def of their base plus the fields survev's skin changes against survev's base (same stats as the base). survevGameConfig: GameConfig paths taken from survev instead of the original (arrays cut to the original's length, so bags keep 4 levels). Later waves extend these lists.
